title: Koncert „Elegia Kościuszki”
about: An elegy for solo flute and wind band for Tadeusz Kościuszko, the Polish general who fought in the American and Polish wars of independence.
note: On 24 March 1794, on the Main Square in Kraków, Tadeusz Kościuszko swore an oath to the nation and began the uprising that carries his name.
The piece is a concerto for solo flute and wind band: an elegy, and an anthem for the homeland.
[Continue the note in your own words: what the flute carries, and how the piece moves.]
